title: A refusal by a system's own code of a Level 1 request (RFC-0018 SE-5)
description: results/<release>/<system>/refusals/slot-<k>.json, written by a reviewer: the run, the refusal line from its last lines and the upstream source line that raises it. `upstream.commit` is the pin the refusal was made at; RUN reads a record only at the commit the row's sessions run (SE-5, amended 2026-11-15), so a record of another pin stays a record and decides nothing there.

refusal.$comment: the refusal line, quoted from the run's last lines

raised_at.$comment: the upstream source line that raises it, linked at upstream.commit

refusal_text_from.$comment: where the refusal's words are written, when not at raised_at

note.$comment: what a reader of the record needs and the fields do not say, such as a run whose records were not imported
